NONE: › If a part of your body is numb, you are unable to feel it, usually for a short time.
（身體部位）麻木的，失去感覺的
› not able to feel any emotions or to think clearly, because you are so shocked or frightened, etc.
（由於過度震驚或恐懼而）麻木的，思維遲鈍的
› to make something or someone feel numb
使麻木，使失去感覺

example: I was lying in a weird position and my leg went numb.
我躺臥的姿勢很奇怪，結果腿都麻了。
My fingers were numb with cold.
我的手指凍僵了。
When she first heard the news, she was numb with disbelief.
她最初聽到這條消息的時候，簡直不敢相信自己的耳朵。
Ever since his girlfriend left him he has felt numb.
自從女朋友離開他之後，他就變得麻木遲鈍了。
The extreme cold numbed her face and hands.
她的臉和手在嚴寒中凍得都麻木了。
The children are still numbed by their father's death.
孩子們仍舊沉浸在父親去世的打擊中，麻木遲鈍。

C: A1 [ C ] (a sign or symbol representing) a unit that forms part of the system of counting and calculating
A1 [ C ] written abbreviation no. a number that is used to mark a particular example of something
A1 [ C ] written abbreviation no. a phone number

S, + sing/pl verb: B1 [ S,  + sing/pl verb ] an amount or total

L only + noun: C2 [ L only + noun ] If people or things number a particular amount, there are this many of them.

S, + sing/pl verb: › a number of a particular description
B2 several of a particular type of thing
› [ S,  + sing/pl verb ] a group of people

C: › [ C ] a particular copy of a magazine
› [ C ] informal a piece of clothing, especially a dress, that you admire
（令人欣賞的）衣服，（尤指）連衣裙
› [ C ] US slang a person with a particular characteristic
› [ C ] a short tune or song
C usually singular: › [ C usually singular ] mainly US informal something that is often said

T: C1 [ T ] to give something a number in a series and usually to write this number on it

example: 25, 300, and a billion are all numbers.
25、300和10億都是數字。
She's very good with numbers (= good at adding, subtracting, etc.).
她非常擅長數字運算。
They live at number 34 Orchard Street.
他們住在果園街34號。
Please write your credit card number on this form.
請把你的信用卡號寫在這張表格上。
What's our flight number?
我們的航班號碼是多少？
I gave him my number.
我把自己的電話號碼給了他。
The number of people killed in traffic accidents fell last month.
上個月，死於交通事故的人數有所下降。
There has been an increasing number of cases of the disease.
患這種病的人數持續上升。
A small number of children are educated at home.
少數孩子在家接受教育。
A large number of invitations has been sent.
大量請柬已經發出。
Letters of complaint were surprisingly few in number (= there were not many of them).
投訴信出乎意料的少。
Small numbers of children are educated at home.
少數孩子在家接受教育。
Large numbers of invitations were sent.
大量請柬已經發出。
Newspapers are produced in vast numbers.
報紙發行量巨大。
I decided not to go, for a number of reasons.
我決定不去，有幾個理由。
On the trip, one of our number fell ill.
旅行期間，我們當中有個人病倒了。
Do you have last week's number of the New Yorker?
你有上週那期《紐約客》雜誌嗎？
He's got all the back numbers (= previous copies) of the magazine.
他保存了這本雜誌過去的所有刊本。
She was wearing a stylish Dior number.
她身穿一條時尚的迪奧長裙。
He's a real sexy number, don't you think?
他真性感，你不覺得嗎？
Sing one of those romantic numbers.
唱一支那種情歌吧。
He tried the usual/that old number about how his wife didn't understand him.
他又重施故技，訴說妻子如何不理解他。
All the folders have been carefully numbered and filed away.
所有文檔夾都被精心編號存檔。
Number the pages from one to ten.
從一到十標上頁碼。

NONE: › a drawing that represents all the numbers that exist, including those greater than and less than zero and irrational numbers such as π
數線
› US also numero uno informal yourself and no one else
自己
› the most important, best, most noticeable, or most famous person or organization in a particular area of activity
頭號人物（或事物）

example: Frank is completely selfish - he only cares about number one.
弗蘭克極端自私——他只在乎自己。
I'm going to look out for number one (= take care of myself only).
我打算只關照我自己了。
She's still the world number one in tennis.
她仍然是世界頭號網球選手。
I'm your number one fan.
我是你的超級支持者。

NONE: › a sign on a road vehicle that shows its registration number
（汽車的）牌照，號碼牌
› If you are numbered among a particular group, you belong to that group.
把…歸入

example: At one time, the club numbered an archbishop among its members.
該俱樂部曾一度把大主教吸納為其成員。

NONE: › the official home of the British prime minister in Downing Street, London, or the people who work for or represent the prime minister
唐寧街十號（指英國首相官邸）；為首相工作（或代表首相）的人；英國政府
› the study of the qualities and characteristics of numbers
數論
› mathematical work performed by people or computers that is often quite simple but takes a long time
（簡單但費時的）搗弄數字；進行運算
› too many to be counted
多不勝數的，不計其數的
› lack of physical or emotional feeling
（身體或情感上的）麻木
› a
numskull
› ability to do basic mathematics
基本計算能力，識數

example: statistics on the literacy and numeracy of twelve-year-olds
關於12歲孩子讀寫和計算能力的統計數據

NONE: › a symbol that represents a number
數字
› able to add, multiply, etc.
有計算能力的

example: Our graduates are literate and numerate and have very good IT skills.
我們的畢業生具備讀寫和計算能力，而且精通網際網路技能。

NONE: › the number above the line in a fraction
（分數的）分子

example: In the fraction ¾, 3 is the numerator.
在3／4這個分數中，3為分子。
Compare
denominator

NONE: › involving or expressed in numbers
數字的；以數字表示的

example: a numerical calculation
數字運算
Keep your files in numerical order.
把你的文件按照數字順序排列。
The UN forces have a numerical superiority over the rebels (= there are more of the UN forces).
聯合國部隊跟叛亂分子相比，人數佔優勢。

NONE: C1 many
許多的，大量的

example: We have discussed these plans on numerous occasions.
我們已經多次討論過這些計劃。
Retailers of this type, once rare, are now numerous.
這種商店從前很少見，但現在已經遍地開花。

NONE: › the study or collecting of coins, paper money, and medals
錢幣（或獎章）學；錢幣（或獎章）收藏；錢幣（或獎章）研究
› a very stupid or silly person
笨蛋，傻瓜

example: Don't do it like that, you numskull!
別那樣做，你這個笨蛋！
